card.name: First word after a drug heading in interaction lists
card.fires_on: The first word or word piece right after a drug name that heads a new entry in a drug interaction list. It is often a section label like Clinical or Mechanism, or the start of the interacting drug's name.

modes.label: Section label after drug
modes.description: The word Clinical or Mechan begins the label after a drug heading.
modes.example: Digoxin<< Clinical>> Impact: Post-marketing surveillance of tram

modes.label: Start of next drug name
modes.description: The first piece of another drug's name begins the entry text after a drug heading.

card.plain: It marks the first word of a new entry in a drug interaction list, right after the drug's name.
